display_long_description:
As Intern Monster #133458 at AHHH MONSTER LTD, you’ll parachute into Crispy City—a tiny town in the middle of the Pacific! Here, you’ll take on the role of a young monster to start your demolition task and fight for a full-time spot!


**🌆City-sized Open World🌆**
[media]
Welcome to Crispy City —  every inch of this place is your playground for wild, chaotic ideas! 


**🦖Giant Monster POV🦖**
[media]
Instead of being a small animal, you now play with the city in a giant monster POV! Grab fleeing citizens to toss around, climbing up the skyscrapers like KONG!


**💥All You Can Destruct💥**
[media]
Unleash your rage in this city-sized physics sandbox — stomp on street cars to send them exploding, punch houses like toy blocks, and torch gas stations until they’re reduced to ash!


**🔨Insanely Destructive Weapons🔨**
[media]
Wield a killer lineup of melee brawlers and ranged shooters! Flamethrower, Slingshot, Mjölnir Hammer, you name it!


**🧪Monster Planet Technologies🧪**
[media]
Earn more Monster Coins to unlock a variety of crazy prank tools exclusive from Monster Planet Technologies! Each has unique functionalities to experiment with!


**📰Make The Headlines📰**
[media]
100+ wacky and funny mischief quests — You will get onto newspaper headlines and even television LIVE!


**📷Chill Anytime Anywhere📷**
[media]
Take a city walk, play with some fireworks, and chill with your airship buddy — Screaming Chicken and Chubby Butt in your monster-sized bed!


Tons of new gears, tasks and citizens added this Christmas! Will you rise to become the top monster at AHHH MONSTER LTD? Good luck!
